general.notes: Power consumption ≤ 4.5 W when stabilized (Tx and Rx CDR locked); may be ≤ 5 W during locking acquisition. Minimum TXPx and TxOMA values are informative. Average Receive Power per Lane minimum (-14.5 dBm) is informative, equals min TxOMA with infinite ER and max channel insertion loss. Unstressed receiver sensitivity at 5x10-5 BER. Stressed Receiver Sensitivity measured with vertical eye closure penalty of 1.8 dB max, J2 of 0.30 UI, and J9 of 0.47 UI; 4WDM MSA conformance test signal at TP3 for 5x10-5 BER. Receiver Return Loss RL min -26 dB. Signaling rates 25.78125 ± 100 ppm. Optical section EOL at TOP -40 to 85 °C, VCC 3.315 to 3.465 V; Electrical section III uses TOP -20 to +85 °C, VCC 3.135 to 3.465 V.
provenance_datasheet_sections: IV. Optical Characteristics (EOL, TOP = -40 to 85 °C, VCC = 3.315 to 3.465 Volts)
general.suggestions: Explicit modulation format (e.g. NRZ) and photodetector type are not stated. No OSNR or chromatic dispersion tolerance parameters appear. FEC is mentioned for applications but FEC type/overhead not specified. Center wavelengths only given as ranges, not nominal center values.
